page, so a partial dictionary degrades to a partly-English page, never a broken
one. Quebec French throughout: courriel, magasinage, blogue, FNB.
WATCH THE HREFS. A call-to-action often sits inside a translation unit, so its
href travels through here with the words. A page that exists in French must be
linked at its /fr URL — scripts/i18n.test.js fails the build if it is not.
